rendering.aspect: Each PNG is a square texture plane; inkAspect describes the contained mark.
rendering.vectorPolicy: Complete archived upstream SVG is rendered without extracting/rebuilding paths. Groups, rects, transforms, fill rules, white negative shapes and source hierarchy are retained.
rendering.negativeSpacePolicy: Render black/currentColor on white, derive alpha as 255 minus luminance, then set RGB uniformly to #171613. White negative shapes and all white canvas become alpha=0.
rendering.sizing: Fit the rendered nonzero-alpha symbol proportionally into 208×208 and center it in the 256×256 texture.

provenance.licenseScope: MIT applies to the 24 LobeHub SVGs. Six legacy tool entries retain their separately recorded licenses and archived source hashes.
